title: Lalalala Game
description: A fast-paced clicking game where you aim, click, and rack up points as quickly as possible.
how_to_play:
1. Press 'Play' to start the game.
2. Click on targets as fast as you can.
3. Earn points for each successful hit.
4. Avoid missing targets.
5. Try to beat your personal high score!

Tips:
- Focus on the center of the screen.
- Stay calm and maintain steady clicks.
